coarse_grid_input_provenance: The initial nine runs did not embed a fingerprint and no pre-run manifest was saved. The common input declaration below is reconstructed from fixed configuration and observable traces; original artifacts are unchanged. Later neighborhood candidates embed their signature. The selected result must additionally pass independent execution and fresh replay against this exact input fingerprint.
reference_information_scope: Offline retrospective reference for one fixed complete synthetic weather sequence; no claim of online robustness or agronomic field optimum.

crop_data.license_note: Upstream maize.yaml metadata declares EUPL without a version. Copyright/attribution and metadata are preserved in the bundled file.
crop_data.calibration: Uncalibrated European reference cultivar; synthetic Harbin scenarios do not establish Northeast China calibration.

crop_backend_provenance.external_biotic_coupling: disabled; soybean biotic models are not adapted to maize

metadata.weather_source: synthetic daily generation, continuous dates 2026-2027; not repeated recorded years
metadata.winter_limitations: no additional snow/frozen-soil process; uncalibrated continuous CWB/CNB experiment

objective: Maximize cumulative safely stored grain from two calendar-year crops
scope: Nine-point coarse grid plus full adjacent-neighborhood refinement of first-season fertilizer allocations [400,600,800] kg product and water caps [100,200,300] mm; second-season fertilizer is remaining 1200 kg; water cap is min(300, 400 minus actual first-season use). Full adjacent two-dimensional eight-point neighborhood refinement uses 100 kg product and 50 mm steps inside the original allocation bounds until no improvement. Fixed May 5 sowing, base fertilizer 200 kg, remaining fertilizer split days 15/30, four irrigation windows days 20/60/70/80. An irrigation window is skipped when any publicly observed soil-probe VWC >=0.28 (including a margin for sensor noise). Cultivar, dates, weather and geometry are fixed. This is not a global optimum.
weather: Continuous reproducible synthetic Harbin climate, seed 101, 2026-2027 distinct dates, declared five-day May 5 dry sowing windows in each year.
winter_limitations: Native CWB/CNB soil continues daily. No added snow or frozen-soil process; uncalibrated winter and reference maize cultivar. Not a regional agronomic recommendation.

interseason_tradeoff_example.interpretation: Joint allocation/timing effect, not isolated causality of total second-year water. The higher first-year cap changes carried allowance, per-event dose, soil state and triggered windows; compare each candidate irrigation_schedule and yearly grain ledgers.
